subject.title: refactor: use semver package for version ordering

question: Should this SemVer consolidation land after the final-head check failures and Codex app-server version contract have been explicitly verified?
rationale: The protected maintainer signal and unresolved exact-head and dependency-contract evidence require a human to confirm merge readiness even though no discrete patch defect is currently established.

options.title: Verify and land
options.body: Confirm the failed checks are unrelated or fixed and inspect the Codex app-server emitted version format, then land the centralized implementation.

options.title: Hold for narrower scope
options.body: Pause the PR and separate the Codex or QA comparator changes if either contract cannot be verified with the core update and plugin behavior.

recommendation.title: Verify and land
recommendation.body: Confirm the failed checks are unrelated or fixed and inspect the Codex app-server emitted version format, then land the centralized implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They defined the intended version policy and are the trusted repository actor associated with the protected maintainer review signal.
